en.summary: Column labels, visible sorts and spacing; Chromium
details: dir              Published site directory; default: public
--headed         Show the browser window
--trace          Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>      Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>   Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>    Page with a sortable breadcrumb column
--column <path>  Collection pathname; default: first sortable column
--widths <list>  Comma-separated viewport widths; test height: 900 pixels; default: 390,1440
swban check/browser/breadcrumb/header ./preview --page /discover/topic/child/
swban check/browser/breadcrumb/header ./preview --page /article/#from=all --column /all/ --trace

zh.summary: 路径列标题、排序可见性与间距；Chromium
details: dir              已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed         显示浏览器窗口
--trace          保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>      在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>   浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--page <path>    含可排序路径列的页面
--column <path>  集合路径；默认：首个可排序列
--widths <list>  视口宽度，用逗号分隔；检查高度为 900 像素；默认：390,1440
swban check/browser/breadcrumb/header ./preview --page /discover/topic/child/
swban check/browser/breadcrumb/header ./preview --page /article/#from=all --column /all/ --trace
